entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse. It's a piece of junk and I want my money back. Now.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It doesn't matter! It's uncomfortable, the battery is terrible, and I just don't want it. Your policy says I can return it. Just process the refund.
I understand your frustration. I just need to pull up your order to verify the purchase details. Can I get the order number or the email address you used for the purchase?

Ugh, fine. The email is angrycustomer@email.com. You'd better not give me a hard time about this. I've seen your website, it says 90 days. It's only been about three weeks. If this takes more than five minutes, I want to speak to your manager.
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up for you... Okay, I see your order from December 18th for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor.
See? I told you. Now are you going to process this or am I going to have to blast VeloFit all over Twitter?

My apologies for the delay. I've just reviewed the details, and you are absolutely correct. Your purchase is well within our 90-day return policy. I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund immediately.
Wait, really? That's it? You're just approving it?

Yes, of course. I've just initiated the return process. I am sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email on file right now. You should receive it shortly. Just place the device back in its original packaging, affix the label, and you can drop it off at any postal service location.
Oh. Okay. I was expecting a fight. Well... good. Thank you.

You're very welcome. We want to make sure you're satisfied. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you, Diana.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
